stock.description: Operating throughout the People's Republic of China, Xi'an Kingfar Property Services Co., Ltd. delivers a comprehensive suite of property management solutions, covering urban infrastructure, residential developments, and commercial properties. Its city-focused services encompass the oversight of public assets, municipal facilities, and specialized value-added offerings for government buildings. For residential clients, the company provides both essential property upkeep and an array of supplementary services. Additionally, it extends tailored management solutions to commercial entities, including office complexes, industrial parks, and manufacturing facilities. Founded in Xi'an in 2000, initially under the name Xi'an Kingfar Property Management Co., Ltd., the company functions as a subsidiary of Xi'an Kingfar Group Co., Ltd.
